source: Read from the running apps and their public API with the browser; no credentials used.

front_end.framework: Nuxt 3 (Vue), Tailwind-style utility classes, Iconify icons (mdi, lucide, hugeicons, heroicons), nuxt-color-mode
front_end.viewer: Sketchfab Viewer API 1.12.1 in an iframe; options show or hide named geometry nodes and assign materials

back_end.cms: Strapi v5 (documentId fields), public REST API, media on Cloudinary (cloud dtqqilt3d)

option: geometry_name (Sketchfab node(s) to show; newline-separated for several)
controls[] (nested controls that appear only when this option is selected)
data_model.price_rule: displayed price = metrics_definitions.property_price.base_value + sum of selected options' metrics.property_price; carbon likewise from embodied_carbon base_value

project.name: HOME@IX Ever After Cottage

img_gen_styles.label: Devon
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional detached house in the UK, Devon neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh roof

img_gen_styles.label: Herefordshire
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional detached house in the UK, Herefordshire neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh roof

img_gen_styles.label: Gloucestershire
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional detached house in the UK, Gloucestershire neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh roof

img_gen_styles.label: Norfolk (stone and render)
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional stone house in the UK, Norfolk neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh tiled roof, natural limestone

img_gen_styles.label: Norfollk (full red brick)
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional red brick house in the UK, Norfolk neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh tiled roof, red and dark brick

img_gen_styles.label: Norfolk (brick and render)
img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional brick and render house in the UK, Norfolk neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh tiled roof, low contrast, red brick on the ground floor, white render on the second floor

img_gen_styles.prompt: a beautiful cinematic shot of a traditional brick and timber house in the UK, Norfolk neighbourhood, newly built in traditional style, fresh look with respect of tradition, amazing architecture, clean fresh tiled roof, red brick on the ground floor, natural timber planks on the second floor

project.note: Each img_gen_style carries one or two uploaded_style_id UUIDs (style reference images for the image generator). Nested Facade Composition and Brick Color option lists for End-Terrace, Mid-Terrace and Flemish were only partly read; the pattern is the same as for Detached and Strecher.

natural_language_configurator.name: Home@ix House Preview (Sign Up Configurator, Natural Language)
natural_language_configurator.front_end: Single-page app, one Vite bundle (assets/index-*.js), hosted on Vercel; bottom bar: my designs, favourites, create (+), gallery, sign in; design card actions: price, share link, regenerate, delete
natural_language_configurator.auth: Clerk (development instance innocent-buzzard-98.clerk.accounts.dev); Apple, Google and Microsoft sign-in or email
natural_language_configurator.back_end: Convex (deafening-axolotl-117.convex.cloud) for data and server functions; the image generator is called from the server side (the bundle references OpenAI, prompt and generate but no provider endpoint is exposed to the browser)
natural_language_configurator.viewer: Sketchfab Viewer API 1.12.1 also loaded, so the same Ever After Cottage model can be shown
natural_language_configurator.link_to_prompted: The Strapi project carries show_img_gen: true and the img_gen_styles prompts above, so the prompted configurator hands a style prompt to the image generator; the two apps share the Home@ix brand chrome
natural_language_configurator.not_inspected: Pages behind sign-in were not opened (no account was created).
